replies.author: PieZ
replies.body:
Your map has been denied by the map devs for the following reasons.

-Layout is too basic: We want maps that can stand out on their own and have gameplay people will remember. Try to put your own spin on it.

-Monument location: The monuments should be pushed a little back and further out.

You may resubmit only when you have edited your map.
